# 捞职 JobLasso · dsh-job-lasso
> 中文说明见 README.zh.md。
I built this because I was job hunting.
Every morning: open BOSS直聘, open 猎聘, open LinkedIn, type the same keywords, switch cities, tick “rem
ote”, scroll, apply, wait. Then do it again the next day. Remote roles are scattered across sites, a
nd many are only marked by the word 远程 somewhere in the title, so manual searching never really ends
d many are only marked by the word 远程 somewhere in the title, so manual searching never really ends.
JobLasso does that loop for me. Once a day it searches the job boards I enable, keeps the remote rol
es, scores every posting against a saved profile, and puts the ones worth reading in a Harness sideb
ar panel. It does not apply for me and does not message recruiters. It just removes the repetitive p
art, so I can spend the time on my resume and interviews.
## What it does

- Searches BOSS直聘, 猎聘, 拉勾 (experimental), 电鸭社区, LinkedIn 领英 and V2EX 酷工作 once a day.
- Remote-first:

the query always carries 远程, and non-remote postings are filtered out.
- Scores each job against ro
le keywords, skills, expected salary, experience, education, exclusion words and a company blacklist

.
- Shows results as today / strong matches / worth a look / saved / ignored, with CSV export.
- Kee
ps everything local: no account upload, no cloud service, no bundled credentials.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI.
- Google Chrome (or Chromium / Edge) installed locally. The plug

in launches its own Chrome profile; it does not touch the browser you use every day.
- A BOSS直聘 acco
unt for BOSS results. 猎聘, 电鸭, LinkedIn and V2EX work without login.
## First run

1. Open **捞职 → 设置**, fill in role keywords, expected salary and skills, and choose the sources.
2. F
or BOSS (and optionally 拉勾), click **登录 BOSS** / **登录拉勾**, scan the QR code in the Chrome window, th

en click **完成登录**.
3. Click **立即捞一次**. The first run usually takes 30–90 seconds because every keywo
rd opens a headless browser page.
## Sources
| Source | Access | Login | Notes |
| BOSS直聘 | headless Chrome + search API | required | Rate-limited; repeated requests trigger `code 3

7` and a cooldown |
| 猎聘 | headless Chrome | not required | Main source of remote postings |
| 拉勾 |

headless Chrome | required + slider | Experimental: Aliyun WAF often blocks headless browsers |
| 电鸭

社区 | public API | not required | Chinese remote / freelance jobs |
| LinkedIn 领英 | guest search API

via Chrome | not required | `location=China`, remote filter, Chinese title/company only |
| V2EX 酷工作
| public API | not required | Latest 10 topics |
## Scoring
| Signal | Effect |

| Explicit remote | +18 |
| Likely remote | +6 |
| Non-remote (remote mode) | excluded |
| Role keyw

ord in title | +16, more for multiple hits |
| Skill match | +4 each, up to +12 |
| Salary covers ex

pectation | +10; below expectation −10 to −16 |
| Experience fits | +4; too senior −10 |
| Education

requirement above profile | −12 |
| Exclusion word / company blacklist | excluded |
Default thresholds: strong ≥ 82, worth a look ≥ 66. Changing the profile re-scores stored jobs.
## Data and privacy

- Jobs, profile and logs live in `~/.dsh-job-lasso/store.json`.
- Browser login state lives in `~/.d

sh-job-lasso/chrome-profile-*`; it is created locally and is not part of this repository.
- The plug

in sends no data to any third party. It only opens the job sites you enable.
- No cookies, tokens or
personal files are committed here; `store.json`, `chrome-profile*` and `.env` are ignored.
## Limitations

- Remote jobs are scarce; 5–20 results a day is normal.
- BOSS rate-limits bursts: at most two queri

es per run with a 25–35 second gap, and a cooldown after `code 37`.
- 拉勾 sits behind an Aliyun WAF t

hat usually blocks headless Chrome.
- LinkedIn cards and some sources do not expose salary; those ro

ws show “salary unknown”.
- The plugin reads search result pages, not full job descriptions; JD text

is not scored.
- Scheduling is in-process: it only runs while Harness is running.
